correctness.rationale: Read the complete assigned RESULT.md, including the Cartesian-tree representation of key leaves as local maxima, ancestor interval-minimum representation of depth, beta-conditional local maxima lemma with boundary corrections, telescoping rational formulas and sign argument. Independently enumerated all n! insertion permutations for each 3<=n<=7, built the actual BST, and checked Cov(D_ni,L_n) at every key: agreement with endpoints, second ranks, and interior G(i)+G(n+1-i) exactly. For t>=3 G(t)<0 and the second-rank cubic is positive for n>=4; limits follow from the rational formulas. Enumeration corroborates rather than replaces the full proof.
